title: Carbon Token Project
tagline: Issuing a crypto currency called Arboreum against living trees
description:
The carbon token project (CTP) gives anyone (individual, business or government) the means of verifying the existence of living trees on their land and provides a financial reward to them for as long as the trees are alive

CTP’s goal is to account for the world’s green assets on a blockchain and issue currency against it. We want to resurrect a world where money is backed by a tangible asset – forests - that serve all life on this planet
how_its_made:
Hardhat, OpenZeppelin, Web3, React, Bootstrap, Polygon



The project is pretty massive so for the sake of the weekend, we focussed on the process for minting an NFT for a living tree. We built a smart contract for minting our NFTs using Solidity and an Open-zeppeling library for ERC721 nfts, and deployed that to Polygon's test network Mumbai.
